tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la nye bar mkho ba'i cha gsum gtor ma bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams kyi cho ga byed pa'i skabs su gtor ma cha gsum mdor bsdus te gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma gsum bshams pa'i dang po phyogs skyong bcu la dbul te/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas ma dag pa bsang zhing*/ rdo rje me'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ā na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas gzi byin bskyed la/ rin po che'i snod yangs pa bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang bar bsams nas/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul du byas la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sar+b+ba dharmā ṇāṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twāta/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas ci 'dod pa'i yo byad thams cad thogs pa med par bsam zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs par bsams la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan// snying rje thabs mkhas thugs dam dkyil po che// lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu// rig 'dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston cing*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs so 'tshal// bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// 'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol// oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ oṃ in+d+rā ya/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ya/ nair ṛ t+yā ya/ wa ru ṇā ya/ wā ya we/ ku bai rā ya/ ī shwa rā ya/ ud+dhāṃbra h+mā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa trā a dhi pa ta ye/ a dh+wa pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ

a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas pas dam la bzhag de nas sngar gyi sngags kyi rjes la/ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ puṣ+paṃ swā hā/ dhū paṃ swā hā/ dī paṃ swā hā/ gan+dhaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas mchod nas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// klu yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to 'dzin// nor skyong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// 'byung po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// 'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/

de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ sngar gyi sngags rnams kyi mthar/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ/ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// lha rnams kun dang gang dag sa steng klu// ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la// swaḥswaḥso sor gtor ma phul ba 'di// rab tu dges pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas su// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas kyang*// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun bcas// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pas phrin las bcol la/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// de rgyud de bzhin gshegs pas bstan// rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa// dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsung*// sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin// lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin// yid kyi sdom pa legs pa ste// thams cad du ni sdom pa legs// thams cad srung ba'i dge slong dag /sdug bsngal kun las de grol lo// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med par// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes pas chos kyi sbyin pa byin la/

srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis chos sgrub pa'i bar chad nye bar zhi ba dang bsam pa'i don thams cad chos dang ldan pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ sngar gyi da sha dika sogs kyi rjes la gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol lo// gnyis pa 'byung po rnams la dbul te/ snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis lha thams cad spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzangs lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e h+ye his spyan drang*/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ gṛh+ṇe dam+ba l+yā di swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang*// dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang*// ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang*// rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang*// chu bo kun dang chu bo'i mdo rnams dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu lteng ka chu ngogs dang*// g.ya' chu sil ma can na gang gnas dang*// grong dang phyugs slas grong khyer stong pa dang*// khang stong dag dang lha yi gnas rnams dang*// gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten gnas rnams dang*// dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres rnams dang*// rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang*// lam srang sum mdo dang ni bzhi mdo dang*// gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung*// dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang*// seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas rnams dang*// 'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang*// gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang*// lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams// rab tu dges shing mgu bar gyur nas su// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces pas 'phrin las bcol zhing*/

snga ma ltar chos kyi sbyin pa dang*/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ gats+tsha zhes pas gshegs su gsol lo// gsum pa bgegs rnams la sbyin te/ rang nyid rigs kyi khro bo gang yin gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcings la/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la 'dir mchis par gyur cig ṭāk+ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod pas bgegs rnams gtor ma len pa'i phyir du 'ongs par bsams la/ oṃ gung ka re gung ka re swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ sarba bigh+nān gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ zhes sogs kyi mchod la/ gong gi sngags gsum gyi rjes su/ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs btags la lan gsum gyis gtor ma byin pas tshims par bsams la/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa// de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi// mchod sbyin 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// bdag cag rnams la phan pa'i yid// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// zhes bsngos pas/ rgyan gyi brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing*// dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jigs gang yang med// 'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// 'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du// rang gi lus la dpe long la// gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig

/oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa// nad de nye bar phyung nas su// gdon de rang gi gnas su deng*// de ltar bdag gis ci nus kyi// mchod dang bsnyen bkur byas pa yis// dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su// bdag gi bsam pa skong bar mdzod// rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing*// 'dir ni bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// nad de rab tu sol mdzod la// gdon rnams rang gi gnas su song*// zhes brjod cing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān gats+tsha/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol la/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar dor zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas pas/ na mas+sa man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/ na mo badz+ra kro dhā ya/ ma hā daṃ ṣ+ṭ+wot+ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la/ pa ra shu pā sha ha stā ya/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi nā ya kā nāṃ/ ma hā ga ṇa pa ti/ dzī wi ta an+ta ka rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas mtshams bcad par bya'o// de bzhin du bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi cho ga rnams kyi skabs su'ang*/ gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab pa rnams so so'i cho ga bzhin sbyar la/ gtor ma'i cho ga ni 'di kho na ltar nyams su blangs pas 'grub bo// 'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud la lha'i nga rgyal gyis mgron dgug pa med pas/ sngon du bdag med gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la sems bzhag la/ de'i ngang las mgron dgug pa sogs bya ba nyid do// de ltar rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi cho ga la nye bar mkho ba'i yan lag gtor ma cha gsum gyi cho ga bsdus pa 'di/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos slob dpon shrar+dhā kā ra war+m+ma'i gzhung dang mthun par slob ma dag gi don du bris pa'o// ༈ /rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor 'bul nyung bsdus bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/

gtor ma chu gtsang mas bran te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa e h+ye hi tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭa ya/ bi rū ḍha kā ya/ bi rū pāk+ṣa ya/ bai shra wa ṇā ya/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis phul/ tsa turma hā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// mar gad mdog can pi wang 'dzin// dri za'i tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo// mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// mig mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo// ded dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang sgyur ba// rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rgyal po chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bsdu na/ dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing*// sgrub la brtson pas sangs rgyas thugs su chud// thabs dang snying rjes gzhan don rdzogs mdzad pa'i// bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud// ces pa'i mthar phrin las bcol/ zhes pa'ang bya spyod kyi dbang rjes gnang sogs cho ga'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu nyer mkho'i slad 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung rab las phyung ba dge legs su gyur cig/

//sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
